name: modal
label: Modal
description: An accessible, teleported dialog (role="dialog", labelled by its header) with focus trapping, header/content/footer slots, and event-driven open/close.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is open on load.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: The stacking z-index for the overlay.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Custom element that opens the modal.

slots.name: content
slots.default: The main body content for your modal will go here.

studio.card: <x-components.modal><x-slot:trigger><x-components.button variant="outline" size="sm">Open modal</x-components.button></x-slot:trigger><x-slot:header>Confirm changes</x-slot:header><x-slot:content>Are you sure you want to save these changes?</x-slot:content></x-components.modal>

examples.title: Confirmation dialog
examples.description: A focus-trapped dialog with header, content and footer slots.
